mapper.select: SELECT d.date, COALESCE(u.cnt, 0) AS newUsers, COALESCE(p.cnt, 0) AS newPosts, COALESCE(c.cnt, 0) AS newComments FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 ) nums ) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM users WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY dt) u ON d.date = u.dt LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM posts WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY dt) p ON d.date = p.dt LEFT JOIN (SELECT DATE(created_at) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM comments WHERE status = 0 GROUP BY dt) c ON d.date = c.dt ORDER BY d.date ASC LIMIT #{days}
